categories.description: Every category, active and inactive, by sort order, then name, then slug.

CategoryName.description: Trimmed; 1 to 80 characters (code points). Blank or longer is a 422.

AuthProviders.description: Which sign-in methods the account login page offers besides a password.

authorizationUrl.description: Google's authorization page. Send the browser there.

state.description:
Keep it in `sessionStorage` and compare it with the `state` Google
returns to `/account/google/callback` before posting the callback.
Works once, for 10 minutes.

AccountUser.description:
A client's own view of their account. Still an allowlist: which
credentials the account holds, never what they are (Phase 8).

phone.description: The client's own number, E.164. Prefills the booking form; never changes a booking already made.

hasPassword.description: False for a Google-only account, which may add one (`POST /api/account/password/set`), cannot change its address, and confirms deletion by typing its address.

hasGoogle.description: Whether the account signs in with Google.

pendingEmail.description: An address change waiting on the link sent to the new inbox; null once that link lapses (24 hours).

AccountPhotographer.description: Whose booking it is, as the public profile names them (`/p/{handle}`).

dueRwf.description: Still to pay; nought once the booking no longer stands.

refundDueRwf.description: Owed back and not yet sent.

holdExpiresAt.description: A `pending_payment` booking's live hold; null otherwise.

checkoutPath.description:
The web app's checkout page for a live hold, `/checkout/{reference}/{token}`
("finish payment"); null once the hold lapses, for any other status, and
when payments are off.

page.description: The page answered; the last one when the one asked for is past the end.

AccountPhotographerContact.description: Who the photographer is and how to reach them (R8.1): the public profile's contact details.

email.description: The public contact address they chose

AccountBookingDetail.description:
The dashboard's booking page: `booking` is exactly the guest page's view
(`GET /api/booking/{token}`), so the same components render it.

checkoutPath.description: A live hold's checkout page, as in the list.

holdExpiresAt.description: When that live hold ends; null whenever `checkoutPath` is.

AccountBookingConflict.description: The refusal, with the booking page as it now stands.

PaidWith.description: The client's method, `cash` for money the photographer recorded by hand, or null when none was recorded.

RefundState.description: Whether this payment is owed back (`due`) or was sent back (`refunded`, with the transfer's reference).

Overpayment.description: The part paid above what was asked, which the platform sends back; null when exactly what was asked was paid.

status.description: Every status but `initiated` in the list; any status in the export.

failure.description: Why a failed payment failed, in the public words; null otherwise.

hasReceipt.description: True for `succeeded`, `refund_due` and `refunded`, the payments `GET /api/account/payments/{ourRef}` answers.

Receipt.description: What the printable receipt page shows (R8.2). A refunded payment's receipt says so in `refund`.

NoReceipt.description: The account's own payment, which took no money (yet), so it has no receipt.

AccountProfileUpdate.description: Any subset; an absent key is left as it is. Text is trimmed; lengths count characters as the database does.

phone.description:
Stored E.164: a Rwandan local `078 123 4567` or `250…` becomes `+250…`;
any other number needs its `+`. Not a phone number is a 422. `null` or
a blank string clears it. Never changes a booking already made: each
keeps its own contact snapshot.

AccountExport.description:
Everything the account holds, and nothing else (T8.4). No hash, token,
Google subject, lockout state or row id; no photographer's private note
(a cash payment's), provider reference or failure text; no deleted note.

contacts.description: The contact records the bookings were made under, one per address, as they now stand.

contact.description: The booking's own contact snapshot, as it was booked.

delivery.description: Once the photos were sent; `url` is null after the link expires.

notes.description: The photographer's notes to the client that are still shown on the booking page.

payments.description: Every payment on the account's bookings, every status, newest first.

DeleteAccountRequest.description:
`{ password }` for an account with a password; `{ confirmEmail }`, the
account's address typed again, for a Google-only account (`hasPassword`
false in `/me`). Both, neither or another key is a 400.

Handle.name: handle
Handle.description:
A photographer's handle, as in `/p/{handle}`: lowercase letters, digits
and hyphens, 3 to 30 characters. Anything else is a 404, as an unknown
handle is.

AccessToken.name: token
AccessToken.description:
The booking's **access token**, from its confirmation email or a resend:
256 random bits, base64url. It is the client's whole identity, so treat
the URL as a secret. Unknown, expired (365 days) and superseded tokens
are all a 404.

CheckoutToken.name: token
CheckoutToken.description:
The checkout token returned when the booking was created: an HMAC of the
reference, 43 base64url characters. Good only for paying the booking fee
while the hold lasts.

OurRef.name: ourRef
OurRef.description: Our id for one payment attempt, returned when it was started.

BookingScope.name: scope
BookingScope.description: `upcoming` (the default): confirmed with the shoot not over, and live holds, soonest first. `past`: completed, no-show, cancelled, and confirmed whose shoot is over, latest first. An expired hold is in neither.

Page.name: page
Page.description: 1-based; past the last page, the last page is answered.

NotFound.description:
Nothing there. For a capability token this is also the answer for an
expired, superseded or malformed token: never 403, which would confirm
that a booking exists. On a studio route it is also the answer for an id
that belongs to another photographer.

BadRequest.description:
Not the shape of a request: invalid JSON, a wrong type, an unknown or
missing key, a malformed id or date.

RateLimited.description:
Too many requests from this address (or, for bookings, this email) in the
window. Nothing was done. `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait.

InvalidCredentials.description:
Invalid credentials. One answer for an unknown email, a wrong password, a
locked account, an unverified address and an account of another kind:
none is disclosed.

ResetConfirmRefused.description: A malformed body, or an invalid or expired token.

ValidationFailed.description: Well-formed, but a value breaks a rule. Names the fields.

VerifyRefused.description:
A malformed body (`invalid_request`), or one answer
(`invalid_verification`) for an unknown, expired or used token, a wrong
password, a locked account and a login since disabled: none is
disclosed. A wrong password counts toward the account's lockout.

Unauthorized.description:
No valid token for this area. The `WWW-Authenticate` header says which:
`Bearer realm="bookly-studio"` (or `bookly-platform`, `bookly-account`) for no token,
`…, error="invalid_token"` for a refused one: expired, tampered, issued
for another area, issued before a password change or a revocation, or
for a login since disabled.

booking.description: The booking as it now stands.

conflict.description: The action was refused; the booking as it stands is included.

slugTaken.description: The slug is already in use.

invalid.description: A well-formed value outside its rules.

inUse.description: A booking or another row still references this; it was not deleted.

package.description: The package, with a warning when it is longer than every open day.

WrongPassword.description:
The password was wrong (`invalid_password`, counted toward the login
lockout) or the account is locked by failed attempts (`password_locked`,
nothing checked).

received.description: The delivery is on record, applied or ignored.

invalidSignature.description: The signature did not verify. The delivery is stored unverified and changed nothing (T3.3).

failed.description: Processing failed; the provider should retry.
